# Support

## Getting Help

If you need help or have questions about using Seed-VC iPad App, here are some options:

### Documentation

- [README.md](../README.md) - Quick start guide
- [CONTRIBUTING.md](./CONTRIBUTING.md) - Contribution guidelines
- [LICENSE](../LICENSE) - License information

### Issues

Please use GitHub Issues for:
- Bug reports
- Feature requests
- Questions about usage

### Community

Feel free to:
- Create an issue for bugs or feature requests
- Start a discussion for general questions
- Contribute code and documentation

## Response Time

We aim to respond to issues within 1-2 business days, though response times may vary.

## Security Issues

If you discover a security vulnerability, please report it privately:
- Create an issue with "Security" label
- Provide detailed information about the vulnerability
- We will respond promptly and keep you updated

## Additional Resources

- [Seed-VC Official Repository](https://github.com/plachta/seed-vc)
- [CoreML Documentation](https://developer.apple.com/coreml/)
- [SwiftUI Tutorials](https://developer.apple.com/tutorials/swiftui)

Thank you for using Seed-VC iPad App! 🎤
